title: 第9章 玩物何敢攀枝头第10章 缝隙渐生
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
玩物何敢攀枝头。
时间一分一秒的流逝，很快就来到了深夜。
“二少爷，天色已晚。”李长春看着在院子里修习刀法的李君肃，提醒道。
“我知道了。”李君肃放下望月，伸了个懒腰。
与李家的祥和不同。
春花楼。
“你说的是真的？”楚大力在春花身上驰骋，眯起眼睛。
“嗯嗯妾身妾身怎麽敢骗官人呢？”春花眼神朦胧的应着。
“好。”楚大力应道，而後开始最後的谢礼。
就在最顶峰的一瞬间，咔嚓的声音响起。
春花连反应都来不及，就这麽了结了自己的生命。
“李家，想挑拨我跟楚夷的关系，还差得远。”楚大力起身，淡淡开口。
“当家的，换一个吧。”楚大力换好衣物，走出房门。
“是，楚公子。”老鸨娇滴滴的应道，对於春花的死亡没有任何反应。
“楼名也该换了，这是三锭金。”楚大力递过一个小袋子，而後径直离开。
“谢谢楚公子！”老鸨眉开眼笑的接下，朝楚大力的背影抛了个媚眼。
等到楚大力走後。
“床铺卷一下，扔乱葬岗去吧。”老鸨对着小厮挥了挥手，有些晦气啊。
剩下的妓女们也没有太大反应。
这里是青楼，谁跟青楼的女人讲感情，她们只会笑你蠢。

而老鸨就更是简单了，已经赚回本了，你没死那就能继续赚，死了，也就这样吧。
一个玩物，居然想着攀上枝头变凤凰了，那是多少万分之一的概率。
能赎身就已经超过八成的妓女了。
玩物何敢攀枝头。
楚家。
“有谁在主位用膳了？”回到楚家的楚大力，看着宴厅冷冷开口。
“报告家主，是少爷他”当值的婢女低着头，战战兢兢的应着。
“是二少爷！他只是一个庶子！”楚大力吼道。
“是家主，是二少爷他”婢女脸色苍白的改变称呼。
“我看你话都说不利索，也不用干了。”楚大力气极反笑，一挥手。
“不不要啊家主！”婢女连忙跪地求饶。
“把她拖下去，卖到春花楼去。”楚大力一挥手，阴冷开口。
“不要啊家主！我错了家主！求求您放过奴婢吧！”婢女只觉得人生一片黑暗，凄惨的求饶着。
愿意进别人家当婢女的，大部分都是想着留着清白身子，堂堂正正做人的，现在这样，无异於把她们推入火坑。
“楚夷。”楚大力感受着身上的黏腻感觉，本就不甚良好的心情变得有些阴沉。
content_en:
How dare playthings climb branches?
Time passed by minute by minute, and soon it was late at night.
"Second Young Master, it's getting late." Li Changchun reminded Li Junsu as he looked at Li Junsu who was practicing sword skills in the yard.
"I understand." Li Junsu put down Wangyue and stretched.
It is different from the harmony of the Li family.
Chunhua Tower.
"Are you telling the truth?" Chu Dali narrowed his eyes as he galloped over Chunhua.
"Uh-huh, I, I, how dare you lie to the officials?" Chunhua responded with hazy eyes.
"Okay." Chu Dali responded, and then began to give his final thanks.
At the peak moment, a clicking sound sounded.
Chunhua didn't even have time to react, so she took her own life.
"The Li family is far from trying to sow discord between me and Chu Yi." Chu Dali stood up and spoke calmly.
"Master, let's change." Chu Dali changed his clothes and walked out of the room.
"Yes, Mr. Chu." The old bustard responded delicately, showing no reaction to Chunhua's death.
"It's time to change the name of the building. These are three ingots of gold." Chu Dali handed over a small bag and left.
"Thank you, Mr. Chu!" The old bustard accepted with a smile and cast a wink at Chu Dali's back.
Wait until Chu Dali leaves.
"Roll up the bed and throw it into a mass grave." The old bustard waved his hand to the young man, which was a bit unlucky.
The remaining prostitutes didn't react much.
This is a brothel. If anyone talks about feelings to the women in the brothel, they will only laugh at you for being stupid.
As for the madam, it's even simpler. You've already made your money back. If you're not dead, you can continue to make money. If you're dead, that's it.
A plaything actually wants to climb a branch and become a phoenix. That is a one in ten thousand chance.
More than 80% of prostitutes can redeem themselves.
How dare playthings climb branches?
Chu family.
"Who is dining at the main table?" Chu Dali, who returned to the Chu family, looked at the banquet hall and said coldly.
"Reporting to the master, it's the young master." The maid on duty lowered her head and responded tremblingly.
"It's the second young master! He's just a bastard!" Chu Dali shouted.
"It's the head of the house, the second young master," the maid changed her title with a pale face.
"I think your words are useless, so there's no need to do anything." Chu Dali smiled vigorously and waved his hand.
"No, no, Master!" The maidservant knelt down and begged for mercy.
"Drag her down and sell her to Chunhua Tower." Chu Dali waved his hand and spoke coldly.
"No, Master! I was the wrong Master! Please let me go!" The slave girl only felt that her life was in darkness, and she begged for mercy miserably.
Most of those who are willing to work as maids in other people's homes want to keep their bodies clean and live uprightly. The current situation is tantamount to pushing them into a pit of fire.
"Chu Yi." Chu Dali felt the sticky feeling on his body, and his already not good mood became a little gloomy.
